content: Yahwedi dompa kadoko me nabugoŋ nabudokolak, unduŋ doktiŋa nemek niŋdok baniŋ tuwot mu tibit.
Negoŋ nadinambune kilihikit momooŋ foloŋ fooŋ dahakulemalat. Kaŋ nanagilune ime kuyahineŋ wooŋ ime naaŋ hakule tilat.
Adi wougigitŋiŋ doktiŋa saŋiniŋ gitipmuŋ namulak. Tiŋa nanagilune talik momooŋ takalilat.

Bepaŋ, nu kwet hogolineŋ be mambip gineŋ yauŋa du nukut hatilaŋ u agaŋ nadilat doktiŋa munta mutibit. Be undugoŋ tuwot mu kadakawit. Maŋgande, nu gabene du dompa kadoko hekidi kuyaŋ mali yawiiŋ u hone yataŋ. Wendoktiŋa welene kulema tilak.
Du nanaŋe momooŋ hinek u memikneye heki’walaŋ namandahik foloŋ miŋgilaŋgoŋ tiulidokonambune nabiiŋ. Tiŋa nalum me loloŋnit wendok tuwot katinanimbune buŋa dakat ilene momooŋ hinek nabudokolaŋ.
Yahwe, nu kaipmuŋ hatiluwene du helemahelemaŋ welegedi hinek nabukahile hinek tiŋa momooŋ hinek nabudokoluwaaŋ. Unduŋ tubune nu helemahelemaŋ du yokeneŋ uŋgoŋ hatiluwaat.
